description:
You are an industrial hygienist preparing a confined space entry permit. You need to look up flammability properties for five chemicals on the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) and compile a structured assessment report.

For each of the following chemicals, search CAMEO Chemicals and find: Lower Explosive Limit (LEL) in %, Upper Explosive Limit (UEL) in %, Flash Point, and Autoignition Temperature:

1. Acetone (CAS 67-64-1)
2. Toluene (CAS 108-88-3)
3. Methanol (CAS 67-56-1)
4. Ethylene Oxide (CAS 75-21-8)
5. Carbon Disulfide (CAS 75-15-0)

Save your findings to /home/ga/Documents/flammability_assessment.txt using this format for EACH chemical:

Chemical: [Name]
CAS: [number]
LEL (%): [value]
UEL (%): [value]
Flash Point: [value with units]
Autoignition Temperature: [value with units]
Flammable Range (%): [UEL minus LEL]

At the end of the file, add an ANALYSIS section that identifies:
- Which chemical has the WIDEST flammable range (largest UEL minus LEL)
- Which chemical has the LOWEST autoignition temperature

Format the analysis section as:
ANALYSIS
========
Widest Flammable Range: [Chemical Name] ([range]%)
Lowest Autoignition Temperature: [Chemical Name] ([temperature with units])
